steps.text: 9:39 P.M. Inside the Rhodes Island Landship

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Phew.... Finally finished.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Good work, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I've gotten to know you all so well. It's like I'm part of the team now, huh?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ahaha. You've really gotten good at this, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Ha... I'm better at this than looking after the circus, that's for sure.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Why don't you apply for a transfer to logistics then?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: You know, people like you who come out of the, uh, more normal world usually end up working in logistics. It's kind of unusual to become a combat operator.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: We've all been wondering why you decided to go to the front lines, actually.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You wonder why, huh...?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: What kind of work would you like to do for Rhodes Island, Orchid?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: The assessments show you have an aptitude for Originium Arts. If you're interested, we could put you on the front lines.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But since you are a civilian with no relevant combat experience, we still recommend that you join a logistics-related section.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Of course, rest assured that even if you go into a combat role, we won't put you in danger. No more than you can handle, anyway.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What does logistics do?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Well... It's a pretty broad department with a lot of functions. But, in general, you can think of it as the jobs that keep Rhodes Island running.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Since there are more clerical jobs, it's well suited to people like you. Folks used to city life.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (He means sitting in an office...?)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I came here for a change. I don't want to spend my life in a cubicle.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I... I want to go into a combat role.

steps.name: Logistics Operator.
steps.text: Are you sure? It can be tough being a front line operator.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes. I want to give it a try.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Okay then.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (I probably shouldn't tell him I wasn't interested in office work.)

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........Let's just say I sort of fell into it.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ah, yeah. That'll happen if you don't know what you're getting yourself into.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, oh yeah...?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But I seem to remember we have a way to deal with these sorts of things. Let me take a look here....

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ah, yep. Here we go.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: 'Combat operators of civilian origin who, within one year of working as a combat operator, find themselves unsuited to the role, may apply for reclassification as a logistics operator. It will be unconditionally approved.'

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: You haven't been here that long, so you should be good to go. Actually, everyone in A6 should be good. Except Spot, since he was a Sargon soldier.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: And even with Spot, I bet we can find a little wiggle room.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh yeah? I never thought about it before.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: It's not like our work is any easier than that of a combat operator. Rhodes Island depends on us to keep moving.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yeah, right. Thanks. I'll think about it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid, are you done yet?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I just finished.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay~

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Well, if it isn't little Popukar. Is she waiting for you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes. I bumped into her on the way and she came along.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Now that you mention it, I think I remember you applied for a double room to share with her?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes. *Sigh* That girl is a handful. And who sends a child that small out to war anyway?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But the rest of the team is either unreliable or even more trouble than she is. So here we are.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid, are you done yet?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Coming. All right, I'd better go.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Don't forget what we talked about. I'll be waiting for your answer.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Ha.... Isn't it ironic? I became a combat operator to ditch the office. And now look at me.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Am I doomed to the rat race, no matter what path I take...?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid, what's a rat race?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's a miserable life, sitting in an office for 8 hours a day, growing fat and sick, doing tedious, menial labor and sometimes putting in overtime.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh... don't get it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Anyway, Popukar, how did you end up at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Um, Dr. Kal'tsit and Dr. Ansel bought me.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What? Bought?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah. I used to work in a lumberyard.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: One day, Dr. Ansel and Dr. Kal'tsit were passing by there and saw me. They played with me all day.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The next day, I don't know how or why, but Dr. Kal'tsit bought me.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A lumberyard?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yes. My mom and dad sent me to work in the lumberyard when I was very young. The boss was sometimes very mean to me. But at least he fed me...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did you ever see your parents again?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh, no.... The boss said my mom and dad went very far away and couldn't come to see me. So I just had to wait.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then Dr. Ansel said that if I was good, Rhodes Island would help me find my mom and dad, and I might see them again someday!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hey, Orchid, why are you hugging me all of a sudden? What's wrong?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Nothing. Sometimes a girl needs hugs is all.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How would you like to be like those boys and girls back there? Doing things in a chair, not needing to run around all the time?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Um, Dr. Ansel asked me the same question, but I don't really understand that kind of stuff. I just know I'm pretty strong.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But I've been trying really hard to learn to read. Then I can help you, and all those boys and girls in the office!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Of course.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah...! Orchid, what happened? You look really sad. Did I say something bad?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not at all. It's my fault. I shouldn't have asked about that.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You're always so nice to me, Orchid. You can ask me anything.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid, why are you hugging Popukar in the middle of the corridor? People might get the wrong idea.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Ahem. Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hi, Catapult!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, hi Popukar.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are you guys going home?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yes. Now why are you all sweaty? You better not be running off to get yourself, and by extension me, into trouble.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Come on, Orchid, give me a little credit. I just finished a session with Midnight.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ......A what with Midnight?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh? Don't tell me you don't know. Unless there's a mission, Midnight works out in the training room every day about this time.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I didn't have anything to do today, so he roped me in, worked my tail off, and finally let me go. Spot's there giving him the business now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How should I know? I figured you'd be up on it. I just know I need to steer clear of Midnight around ten o'clock.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I knew about it! Midnight also got me to join. But then I hit him and he flew away and he didn't ask me again.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Bwahahahahaha! So that's the story. No wonder he dodged the question when I asked if he told you. Hahaha! My sides!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...All right. As long as you're not making trouble.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why do you always come back to that?! This is discrimination, Orchid. You're always so nice to Popukar, even when she makes trouble!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'd be so nice to you if you'd also go and sweetly apologize every time you did something bad.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That's beyond me. And if I have to apologize for stirring things up, then where's the fun in it?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just stay out of trouble to begin with!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're lucky you're at Rhodes Island, anywhere else would have... Never mind. Forget it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Come on, Orchid, just come out with it. Nowhere else can handle my personality. And I don't wanna change. Only Rhodes Island would want a freak like me!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But everybody here is talkative and awesome and the work is good and it pays well. I love it here.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *Sigh*. Great. As long as you're happy.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Anyway, hurry back and take a shower. A girl shouldn't be out walking around all sweaty.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sure~

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, Orchid, the dorms are the other way.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm going to check out the training room.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh. Popukar, why don't you come to my room tonight? I'll tell you a story.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay~
Training Room

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Did you skip dinner, Midnight? Kinda weak.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: My swordsmanship is about agility and cunning.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Keep talking. Music to my ears.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Ah hah!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Slow. But not bad. I can tell you did eat enough after all.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Wow, Midnight and Spot are fighting.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Can I...?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's wait for them to finish.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh——

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Pfft. *Pant*... water, please.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ........Phew. Thanks.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your military lineage shows, Spot. You're usually so lethargic, but you're clearly much better than me at this.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You've got something to be proud of. If you didn't have the basics, I'd have my comics in one hand while I fought you with the other.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Am I so weak?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: How can I get my point across without hurting your feelings?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But I'm actually curious, you were an escort before, right?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You've got the fundamentals. I can tell. A couple years of practice.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That's not up to military standard. But for a civilian, you can fight.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Can I take that as a compliment?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I'm mostly trying to convince myself that the most useless guy on our team actually has something to offer.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Haha... Actually...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Midnight! Spot!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Orchid's here. You're boned.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I don't know, but she looks like my mom did whenever things were about to get real bad for me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, you're wrong about that. And it's my turn to teach you some tricks for dealing with women.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: *Snort*.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Good evening, Miss Popukar, Miss Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: As you can see, I'm doing my daily exercise.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And why don't I know about this routine?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I never thought you'd be interested, Miss Orchid. And it's all on my own time.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Fair enough.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But we're normal people. And Instructor Dobermann made it clear that civilian teams like us won't ever end up on dangerous missions. So what's the point?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, good question. Mm, a truly fantastic question, Orchid.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Let's take a break for now, shall we, Spot?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Yeah, whatever. I'm just here to help out. I'll go get a comic book to read.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid, do you know what the secret to success is in my line of work?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That's a rhetorical question, to start things off. I can continue without an answer.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'd guess the trick is to be handsome, first and foremost. And then be a decent talker?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No, no, and no. Although I consider myself quite beautiful, and I do know how to pay a compliment...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Bleh.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What's wrong with Spot?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Nothing, just looking at a clown in a whole new light.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Heh heh. Confidence is very important. But by far the most important is to treat all your clients equally.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That is——When you step into my realm, my presence, then, whoever you are, the only thing you are, is my client.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........What's the point of all this? Are you trying to say that everyone's the same to you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Not at all, my dear sweet captain. Clever as you are, you've never thought this through.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's not that everyone's the same to me. It's that, simply, everyone's the same.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The iron-fisted career woman, tyrant of her office section, could actually just be wearing a mask for the sake of her work. If she wears it long enough, she may forget how to take it back off.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The outwardly homely housewife, whose husband likely cheated on her long ago, she stays at home telling no one of her troubles, with no choice but to come to drink with me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: An ill-tempered fashion designer with her strong woman facade may just fear the gossip of others, and the resulting loss of trust.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you have a death wish?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Ha ha, did you think I was talking about you? People like this abound.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Everyone in the city, after unloading their identities and responsibilities, is exactly the same. Each and every one.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: So why, at Rhodes Island, would things be any different?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do the elite operators who go diving headlong into a warzone, come back and unplug themselves like so much machinery?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No, they drink and chat in the bar. They care for their freshly potted plants in the greenhouse. They listen to music, they read.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: They complain when a mission is too hard, or chuckle at how hilariously easy it was. They cry, they laugh, they mope, they hurt, and they die.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: They're no different from us, are they?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...You're a boy who knows how to give a speech.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thank you for the compliment.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...*Sigh*. That all makes sense. But I still feel like it's not completely true.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And I can't blame you for that. My industry, as it is, always had a bit of an underbelly to it. I have that advantage.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But not you, Orchid. You grew up entirely in the light of day.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The greatest hardships for you were lower pay than you'd like, insufficiently clear skin, traffic on your commute. Those sorts of things.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: This world of violence and bloodshed is indeed a brave new world for you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But you're here. You made your choice. Shouldn't you at least try to understand it instead of shackling yourself to the common sense of your past?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The common sense of my past...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'm not trying to be preachy. I'm definitely not qualified to preach. But wouldn't the 'fashion guru' of Rhodes Island understand that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Even you know about that, huh?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I've talked to quite a few senior operators. I've heard a lot of interesting stories.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And you're getting in good with them?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I get in good with anyone, as long as they understand my language. This is my special power as the Devil of the Eastern Night.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: So you know perfectly well that the people who ask you to design their outfits and give fashion tips are ordinary people like us, don't you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: By the way, Spot. You asked me why I knew how to fight when I was just an 'escort.'

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Huh? Ah, oh yeah, I forgot.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You wound me. This is a bit of a story, so let's take it to the cafeteria. My treat.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sounds like a pain in the ass. Can I pass? I don't really care.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Heh heh. I'm afraid not.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Damn. I blew it. I should've slipped out halfway through.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I said it was my treat, but you could still show a little decorum...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Do we have to?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Mmmmm..... It's so good! Why aren't you eating, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I never eat after dinner.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That's the mark of a modern woman.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Ahem, right, back to business then.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: First of all, if I may be so bold as to ask, Orchid, how did you contract Oripathy? If that's too personal a question, you don't have to answer.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........It's not a great story. Just one day I suddenly noticed a little crystalline growth on my body.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The doctors said I must have been exposed to some Originium without even knowing. I still don't know exactly how I got it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Ah, I see. No wonder you're having this little crisis.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: So, let me tell you my experience.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There was a younger man working in my club.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He was my polar opposite: bright, sunny disposition, straightforward. Instantly likeable.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Of course, no one who works in my industry could be called naive. But if I'm the type to make malicious assumptions about people, he's the type to trust them.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sounds like the type I would hate.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Is that your way of saying you like me, Spot?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Orchid, is there really no cure for narcissism?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll ask Medical later. Maybe there's hope.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Heh heh. As I said before, I treat all my clients equally. Meaning I don't change my approach based on one's status or identity.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I make an active effort towards that goal. But for him, it was second nature.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: From my position atop the industry, I could see that he would be the one to surpass me.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So that person surpassed Midnight?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........It can't be that simple.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ........Yeah, it would be nice if that was the whole story.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Now that I think about it, I actually did him a disservice. He didn't come from a good family. He needed the money. To him, I must've looked like the king of the world.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: If I was out of his way, he would have been able to make it in that world.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I should have taught him much earlier how to situate himself, how to handle money, and how to be what people needed him to be.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Had I done that, maybe we wouldn't have ended up at each other's throats.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: He was jealous of you? And you didn't notice?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ........He hid it well. Or rather, he didn't even notice it himself.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It wasn't until he almost killed me the first time that I realized this flaw in my understanding of human nature.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I think it's got nothing to do with human nature. You're just too nice.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right? I never thought of you as the type to mentor a newbie.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But Midnight is a really good man! I always knew!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thank you, Popukar.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But you said 'first time,' which means there was a second time.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He did almost kill me the first time. Almost. I'm confident, had that been his second attempt to kill a man, I wouldn't be sitting here.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But I am.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I bet five Lungmen dollars you bitched out.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No. I didn't. It's just... I couldn't have expected what happened next.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: At the time, I saw the world as Orchid does. I never thought of it as a place of malice and bloodshed.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I muscled him out of the industry and learned how to handle a sword. I thought that would be enough. I really did.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Until one day, I discovered a health problem.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Your Oripathy....

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: He paid my agent to infect me somehow.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The second time he came looking for me, he was Infected himself. And he brought his 'friends' with him.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I had seen a lot of hate in my work. I thought I understood it. But when it was actually directed at me, I felt it burning in a way I hadn't ever before imagined.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But you won.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I did. Even if I can't go toe to toe with you, I can fight off a dozen thugs and walk away with my life.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It was then, with my own hands, I took his...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Waaaaaaahhhhhh!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What's wrong, Popukar?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Poor Midniiiiiiight! Waaaaahhh...

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Don't cry, Popukar.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Honestly, I should thank him for showing me how immature I was.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: After that, I learned about a place called Rhodes Island and made up my mind to leave the industry and come all the way here after registering with the office in Higashi.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Along the way, I saw a lot, and thought a lot more. I came to Rhodes Island with a deep understanding of this one thing.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What are you looking at?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Let me share my thoughts with you, Orchid.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'm not trying to say that because we've seen the cruel reality of the world here, we need to accept it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: From our point of view, it's only natural to think that most of Rhodes Island's operators have been through unnecessary pain.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We shouldn't feel inferior for having grown up in our relative safety, but it isn't an excuse for us to fight it either.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Life is the same everywhere.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Where we used to live, the only way to get what we wanted was to work hard and earn money. It's actually the same here.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We could have chosen to join the logistics department and put in the same effort there. But I chose the path of war.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........Aren't you afraid to die?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I think we're all afraid to die.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But as you've learned in your time here, Orchid, sooner or later you have to fight to defend something.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: This would be a fine time to say 'I'm training hard so I can be strong to defend you, Orchid,' but I'd like you to think about something instead——

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What kind of life do you want to lead at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........I understand.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Um... but I don't...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Good. This is something you'll never have to worry about. Why not eat up instead? Here, you can have mine.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Wow, thanks Spot!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hehe. He's right. You don't have to worry about this stuff, Popukar.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And forgive me for dumping all this on you, Orchid, but the question you asked me is one I've been asking myself a lot since I came to Rhodes Island. So I had a lot to say about it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: .......Well, thanks for that.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, wonder of wonders, miracle of miracles! The blessed savior Orchid has finally shown me gratitude! Brother Spot, Sister Popukar, such luck you have brought me!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're a dead man. Popukar, we need to get to bed. We have a big day tomorrow.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh, we're done?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We're done.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay.... Good night, Spot. Good night, Midnight.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Good night.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Sweet dreams to the two beautiful ladies.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: So you're not worried we'll turn out like the guy from your club?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Heh heh. Not to toot my own horn, but I have a lot more confidence as a judge of character these days.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: *Snort*.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Besides, we're on the same team. It's good to get to know each other better, no?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sure. But I never imagined you'd be hung up on all that garbage.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Now that I've thought it through, I don't need to trouble myself anymore.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I guess so. Say, did you use any of those tricks for dealing with women just now?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I did indeed. The most important trick of all——telling the truth.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Sounds pretty easy to me.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's important because it's simple.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid, when we get back, can Catapult tell me a story?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not tonight. Midnight kept us out too late.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay. I'm just glad to see you happy, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh? Have I been unhappy lately?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Um, I don't know how to say this. But you seemed very upset after we left the logistics department. Not now though. Now you look happy.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did I...? I guess I did.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Thank you, Popukar.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Did I do something?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hehe. You just don't know it yet.
Excuse me, are you Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh? You are...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm Sora, with Penguin Logistics. I've heard you're kind of an expert on fashion, and pretty handy with a needle and thread. Can I talk to you for a minute?
6:23 P.M. Inside the Rhodes Island Landship

steps.name: Logistics Operator A
steps.text: So you decided to carry on as a combat operator. That's too bad. But it's your call, Orchid. We'll respect it.

steps.name: Orchid.
steps.text: Yes. It may not be a good fit for me, but it's a special opportunity. I don't want to waste it.

steps.name: Logistics Operator A
steps.text: That's true. Sitting in the office all day is pretty boring.... Maybe I should apply for a transfer and try it out.

steps.name: Logistics Operator B.
steps.text: You're dreaming. You wouldn't last two seconds with Dobermann.

steps.name: Logistics Operator A
steps.text: Oh yeah, I've heard about that one. It's pretty cool you made it through her training, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You get used to it... Anyway, that's all for today.

steps.name: Logistics Operator A
steps.text: Heading back so early?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Yeah, I have a thing.

steps.name: Logistics Operator A.
steps.text: Okay, see you tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: See you tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oof... All these aches. That's what I get for skipping the gym that long.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can't even move my hand to fill out a form.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Ugh, why did I do this to myself?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid!!!! There you are. I've been looking for you!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ........What's the matter? What did Popukar break this time?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Nothing. It's Midnight, he's sparring with Popukar. You've gotta see this!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Okay. I'm totally out of it today anyway.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What made you want to sign up for fitness training? It's not like you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Call it a change of heart.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh. Want me to give you a shoulder rub?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay, out with it, what did you do this time?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Woah, hey, I didn't do anything!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll believe you, for once.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You seem kinda different lately.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do I?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I can't quite put my finger on it... But yeah...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Come on, weren't we going to see Midnight eat shit?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hell yeah we were!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Go looking for trouble and you just might find it.
